meta.what: Daytime ground heat on one clear midsummer pass a year, for every field of 40 acres or more in Adams, Lincoln and Whitman counties.
meta.source: NASA ECOSTRESS on the International Space Station
meta.product: ECO_L2T_LSTE v002, land surface temperature, 70 m, tiled (MGRS), LP DAAC Cumulus
meta.rule: Mean of the 70 m squares whose centre is inside the field, leaving out cloud, water and squares with no temperature; given only when at least half the field is clear. Kelvin to °F, whole degrees. A field mean over 160 °F (a fire or a bad reading) is left out.
meta.choice: Each year, the daytime orbit from 20 June to 31 August (local solar time 10:30 to 16:30) with the most clear ground over the fields, preferring July and midday.
meta.legend_why: The map colours run from the 2nd to the 98th percentile of every field-year, rounded out to 5 °F.
meta.format: fields: { id: [°F for each year from years[0], null when the pass missed the field or it was cloudy] }
